lines.text: 这个早晨终于把它合上
虽然时钟指着不同的时间
想回去的地方只有一个
那是我一直想听见的声音
还没来得及喊出你的名字
欢迎回来，欢迎回来，欢迎回来
只这一句话，就让我满心欢喜

provenance.correction: Native reference cross-checked with large-v3 full/stem VAD and no-VAD, focused windows, and independent MOSS vocal transcription. No human listening sign-off.
provenance.timing: Selected-render ASR word anchors; subdivision inside recognizer words and translation highlights are approximate.
provenance.notes: The render omits あとひと眠りで, repeats ダウンを脱いで in chorus one, sings おかえり three times in the final chorus, and ends with three distinct ただいま entrances. Focused no-VAD recovers the two missed outro entrances and corrects the stretched final-line start. Preserve sound-close native source and intended 千葉 despite imperfect nasalized pronunciation. No instrumental or nonlexical opening syllables are lyric rows.
